notes.title: Dev Log: Weapons
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I’ve been working on improving the weapon system! Here’s what’s new:

[h3]Weapon Types[/h3] 
You can use melee weapons for close combat or ranged weapons for long-distance fights. Some weapons have higher or lower range, letting you pick the best option for each situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/2ba2618eebf326463b6ce08b0e39cdacbc89957b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/133fb1bf682b96bf006cd3c862438cb59158cc3b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/31dbf84d339d1d518bc62d29af6eca49949e6e72.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/58f8a4409666f79f89eeaf78e2f3286e31c299ee.jpg[/img]

[h3]Crafting & Upgrading[/h3] 
You can craft weapons, upgrade them, and create ammo. Improve durability, increase damage, and customize your gear to fit your playstyle. Also you can learn abilities to improve your melee and shooting parameters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/e19ca4b7716f7014c10f7dfba137fe2dfd9f56d9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/f661278e8bf4f7066578d4ba346ab4c323f42289.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/504b4c7188450f4f70dc623f8ea78eb80abe554b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Exclusive Weapons[/h3] 
Rare weapons with special skins and stats can be found in supply boxes or secret locations. Keep exploring to discover them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/fbc03faf3d5945458357c3fc33bcd9aeb233c2b2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/81a703f75bfd6043d3736b57b6fdef43a7f60c05.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a06c578586a0a38302776ed2f4a467c5794919e5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/ef7e832cd774fd66f1234ecffef2d60cf30c2b07.gif[/img]


[h3]Hit Effects[/h3] 
Weapons react differently depending on what you hit—concrete, metal, water, dirt, and more all have unique sounds and visual effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/c77a7f0866a371a40711cbf34ef0ef57369e60bf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/bde63c3711647b1cde1db67f9c9bbdd63adf67d2.gif[/img]

[h3]Rocket Launcher, Crossbow & Flamethrower[/h3]
I’m working on adding new weapons - the rocket launcher, crossbow and flamethrower. They’re still in development, but they’ll bring some explosive and fire-based fun to combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/cebd6d51ebb4dde520337684d5ed3a30c03c204c.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now! Let me know what you think, and if you have any ideas for new weapons or features.
[h3]Don't forget to follow, wishlist game to receive notification when game will be available.[/h3]

notes.title: Dev Log: Energy System
notes.content:
[h3]Surviving Without Power[/h3]

[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

I wanted to share some exciting updates about the game! As you explore the island, you'll quickly notice something unusual—there’s no regular electricity here. But don’t worry, I’ve designed some unique and fascinating ways for you to power up devices and keep things running. Let me take you through how the island’s energy system works.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/ce5f15ef2617ac3d60f7eba6437879fb54a7d863.jpg[/img]

[h3]Daytime Power: Generators and Solar Panels[/h3]

During the day, you’ll need to rely on generators and solar panels to power your devices. Generators are a dependable option, but they run on fuel, so make sure to keep those canisters handy for refills. For a more sustainable solution, you can craft solar panels—though they require advanced materials and crafting skills. It’s all about resourcefulness and planning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/1beeb7d26960e23cdd68548069f136c1d11f48e1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Nighttime Magic: The Mysterious Light Beam[/h3]

Here’s where things get a little strange. At night, a mysterious light beam provides electricity to the entire island. Suddenly, all the streetlights turn on, and every device comes to life without needing a generator or solar panel. It’s an eerie but fascinating phenomenon that adds a touch of mystery to your survival journey. Why does it happen? Well, you’ll have to play to find out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/2eddce2ba23fd95952bf64834480fb19ec4aa295.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a553190ee157eeb5296bf09f8ede3aeacc5b1a3a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Experimental Tech: Red Crystals and the Portal[/h3]

I’m also introducing a new experimental power source—red crystals. Certain devices on the island, like the Portal, are powered by these crystals. To activate the Portal, you’ll need to hunt down and collect five red crystals. Once you’ve powered it up, the Portal can teleport you to a new area on the map—a winter biome with its own unique challenges and opportunities. It’s a game-changer for exploration and survival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/3c1bcc387736a49f1622e4b1122229fb479ac202.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/e5ff80a313604479089149a7702cf89789597abe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/14e9c9de2924990443a7be3dc681cc270a310f55.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/98d28c0a0ba9f72d1e77cf9f52f2156ddf95dab6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/cca2a9706a34f192d74aefcb0ca9f8fdb0912b16.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/9bd0229fc659748663f143019556415ecfa9cffb.jpg[/img]

I hope this gives you a better idea of how the island’s energy system works. It’s not just about finding fuel or crafting advanced tech; it’s also about uncovering the mysteries of the island and adapting to its unique environment. I can’t wait to hear what you think about these features. Let me know if you have any feedback or suggestions!

[h3]Don't forget to add game to Wishlist![/h3]

notes.title: Dev Log: Farming
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

I'm excited to share some new farming features that I've been working on for the game. These features are aimed at making your survival experience even more immersive and rewarding. Here’s a quick rundown of what you can expect:

[h3]Building Garden Beds[/h3]

You can now build Garden Beds in your farm location. These beds are perfect for planting and growing a variety of plants. Whether you're looking to grow herbs or vegetables, garden beds are essential for your farming journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/4f4411f57f5ab8e7839d620e9c90162cfda30996.jpg[/img]

[h3]Crafting a Farming Station (Shed)[/h3]

One of the new additions is the ability to craft a Farming Station, also known as a shed. Here you will be able to craft new seeds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/32a6df337a3610bec65f88091b87d19d1ef4868a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Getting Started with Planting[/h3]

To start planting, you'll need to have seeds and garden soil. You can find seeds throughout the game world or craft them from vegetables and fruits using the Garden Shed with the Farming Station. Garden soil is essential for providing your plants with the nutrients they need to grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/cf4d7a225bac6411afab3ad0bd18dd4b80b01e03.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/9d58411964861dcf556d06402c5d38b3e8ff468a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Watering Your Plants[/h3]

Once you've planted your seeds, you'll need to add water to help them grow. You can use a bucket to water your plants, ensuring they stay healthy and grow efficiently. Remember to check on them regularly to keep them hydrated!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/16ff4865055844e31452afadee136dc14232098f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/de4e0d4ec29a5c0554dab3cd62f1b03f161035bc.jpg[/img]

[h3]Harvesting Your Crops[/h3]

After your plants have finished growing, you can harvest them for eating or cooking. There are several types of plants you can grow, including herbs, beets, cabbage, carrots, eggplants, radishes, potatoes, peppers, berries. Each plant has its own unique benefits and uses, so experiment and find out which ones work best for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/bd59075b1bdb27478d114d622b6e2368fa05ddf5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Building Greenhouses[/h3]

To enhance your farming experience, you can build Greenhouses. These structures improve the growing conditions and speed up the growth of your plants. Additionally, you can upgrade your farming skills at the Knowledge Station to unlock more farming abilities and optimize your crop production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/2a373472a865d49346b4981b213976488bc77e5b.jpg[/img]

Collecting Berries and Mushrooms

While exploring the island, you can also collect berries and mushrooms in the forest. These resources are valuable for crafting, cooking, and survival. Keep an eye out for them during your adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/7f603645de13063d2b020982dab2bae8e18a2731.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/639603e714e3ba5fd440b99c5b351316553022dd.jpg[/img]

Let me know what you think, and if you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to share and don't forget to WISHLIST and FOLLOW Outbreak Island.

notes.title: Dev Log: Players Menu (Pre-Final), Abilities
notes.content:
[h2] Hey everyone! [/h2]

I'm super excited to share some details about the game I'm working on. We've shared glimpses of this before as a work in progress, but now it's more final and polished. Let me take you through the Player's Menu, which is your go-to place for everything you'll need in the game.

[h2]Exploring with Confidence: The Map[/h2]

Your journey begins with the map. As you explore new territories, the map will reveal all the locations you can discover, each one filled with resources and secrets. Keep an eye out for landmarks that might be crucial to your survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a2c8dbf1af2860811f077601a6a7447f36f09a96.jpg[/img]

[h2]Organizing Your Gear: The Inventory[/h2]

Survival isn't just about what you find; it's about how you manage it. I've designed the inventory system with separate slots for ammo and other items, making it easy to find what you need. There's also a weight system, so you'll have to be smart about what you carry. Balance is key!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/d375b48d7f5706c057d69a9f7f51d8c5e27266ed.jpg[/img]

[h2]Keeping Track: Story Quests Journal[/h2]

The Story Quests Journal is where you'll find all the main quests and storylines. This is your guide through the game, helping you stay on track and uncover the mysteries of the world. Whether you're forging alliances or uncovering secrets, the journal has got you covered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/65e907ab44f16a4f48ae7bbffea90e4a8572d8e0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Taking on Challenges[/h2]

Survival is about more than just staying alive, it's about rising to the occasion. The Challenges section offers various tasks like crafting car upgrades or surviving for a set number of days. Completing these challenges will reward you with resources and achievements that will help you on your journey.

[h2]Learning the Basics: Tutorials[/h2]

For those new to survival crafting or looking to hone their skills, the Tutorials section is full of helpful guides. From crafting basics to advanced techniques, these tutorials will ensure you make the most out of every opportunity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a89bb5412b024e64db0454f98b7cc92cde725d13.jpg[/img]

[h2]Unlocking Abilities: Knowledge Points and the Knowledge Station[/h2]

As you complete challenges and story quests, you'll earn knowledge points. These points are invaluable and can be spent on a variety of abilities at the Knowledge Station. Whether you want to become a sharpshooter, enhance your resilience, or master the art of stealth, the Knowledge Station has something for everyone. Each ability requires a certain number of knowledge points to unlock, so choose wisely and enhance your survival skills to the max!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/2bf31f7542c0017a91a86bcb70b2a6efc1db2df2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/72c0207fa1466e66b0ef131669141fdbe7b48385.jpg[/img]

Add the game to your Steam wishlist, and we’ll see you on Outbreak Island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/b34b15d462327f0da0cf8fe726caf4a01f199552.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/8eaa70d41a8afb3e8380c562a2d469568548a5ea.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Work in Progress: shooting, vehicle, locations and optimization
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, mystery seekers![/h2]

Today, we want to share some news about the development progress of Outbreak Island, covering locations, vehicle improvements, shooting mechanics, and optimization.

[h2]Location Enhancements and More Loot[/h2]

Until recently, the roads between locations on the island were quite barren, but now we’ve added various objects like houses, abandoned cars, and much more. And all these objects aren’t empty — you’ll be able to find valuable items in them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/4792e3d2667857ef4605b93693b0b22a3ef95b05.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/eaa396c160b08217b7bd14e6d992973e9e54c66a.jpg[/img]

By the way, speaking of items, we’re developing a system that will distribute various items across locations. You’ll now need a vehicle to transport all the essential crafting and survival items back to your base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/6e415fe5e136d664f1edcca499214a1c5e4b8c15.gif[/img]

[h2]Vehicle Improvements[/h2]

The vehicle is your indispensable companion for survival on the island, so we continue to enhance it.

The first thing we've improved is the vehicle’s physics. We've reworked the suspension behavior, improved collision physics, and enhanced the car's off-road capability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/7ba211b25a0b5d11651c06a88e754a55f9e5fc3e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/fa3c56bb05b8a79f10d7109318ed12de11709565.gif[/img]

But your vehicle, like you, is not invincible. It will take damage from bullets, heavy collisions, and attacks from various creatures. Who knows what you might encounter on the roads of Outbreak Island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/d1f0015a12891bc1cf67728ea38fddbce6a745e2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/dd22bcb5f2da0f7404fa803fbdd6d437da6e481a.gif[/img]

[h2]New Bullet Impact Effects and Explosive Objects [/h2]

A blown-up car isn't the most pleasant sight, but what about exploding fuel barrels? You can detonate them when enemies are gathered around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/785ad22afb9a5dc0dec7729ce4b3779cc40f9cd9.gif[/img]

We’ve added various bullet impact effects for different objects. Now you can shoot at anything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/d7ed3a132535d021917252a7800f833ae739fe80.gif[/img]\

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a3108771103f219d4f340f9c3cc2db1507d021c5.gif[/img]

[h2]Game Optimization[/h2]

We’ve also focused on optimizing the game and have achieved significant improvements, doubling the FPS in some locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a8b65c6012b280ff92c394e3de28028abb84b1bb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Outbreak Island Community[/h2]

Recently, we've started publishing small devlogs in our Discord. Join us to keep up with the development process, chat with the developers, and join in upcoming activities.

☎️[b]Discord:[/b] discord.gg/DPC98xU

notes.title: Work in Progress: Updated Locations, Car and Crafting
notes.content:
[h2]Hello mystery hunters![/h2]

It's been a long time since we've reported on the progress in development and it's time to share: we will tell you about redesigned locations, crafting, the car, and much more.

[h2]Redesigned locations[/h2]

We rework and improve locations. If you played Outbreak Island: Pendulum, you might remember the location with the player base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/8babba5f39c158c02770442a2ea5a0923bfee2b0.jpg[/img]

Here's what it looks like now: a large area with several buildings. Here, you can find loot, uncover a few secrets, and use the garage to repair or upgrade your vehicle. Additionally, this location features a weapons crafting station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/668ce6bd87c033b88f071a0d10a2e3548ac88eca.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/e3e16b0c98139b48aa6b7d6ab363e5c064ccec48.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/912e1f697a9493c20bfd5c86a12e0431acf74b96.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/43316c7a1f40c5b85e1b4394fac3144f3a41febb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/3150d724a50f4ac685078fca190acdeb29bcd301.jpg[/img]

The farm you may have seen in previous trailers now serves as the main player base. Here, you sleep, eat, store items, upgrade equipment, craft, and much more. 
Initially, the house will be in ruins, giving you the opportunity to restore it as you progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/ac1e89c0f0c120f5e0dbd62f369035bd84376511.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/c0e6360b0a977b305b99432c01887dca70f8250d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/abc063449d5d4a0274d7db62ee73777e5cdb7d42.jpg[/img]

[h2]Crafting[/h2]

On the farm, there's an old crafting station where you can create tools, unlocking new crafting recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/ffad234e55f131a85316af23ddd1f6a992b25cdf.jpg[/img]

This workstation is now much improved: it has more tools and more options to choose between. Each tool is represented visually and you can see it in the world on the tool board.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/44b3bfe0fe8d12a126be0feee06f4f9a1bd3a79d.jpg[/img]

We are expanding the crafting possibilities by adding new recipes, tools, and structures that you can rebuild. In the future, additional tables will be available for creating more complex items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/b8470abb5672b387142e48fd177726497dc2546d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/432cc58066ba34bbe18ff7022ba44221757fea9b.png[/img]

[h2]Your car [/h2]

Your car will become an ideal companion in your survival on the island. It will help you traverse across large territories, transport crafting materials, and carry supplies for survival. Your mobility and ability to survive will be directly linked to your car.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/69c3a0ce7b17bdeb9885314a3b79ef462aac0538.png[/img]

However, the car needs regular servicing and refueling. You will have to plan your travels carefully, take gas tanks with you and keep an eye on the condition of the car. Regular service and timely refueling will allow you to avoid unpleasant surprises in the most unlikely places on the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/8cb80ede01e8e80b78c7c6a7bb69dc28db5e1465.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/a95095b9d7acf63e5d40906b4c00464f2be5b42b.png[/img]

[h2]Outbreak Island Community[/h2]

Recently, we've started publishing small devlogs in our Discord. Join us to keep up with the development process, chat with the developers, and join in upcoming activities.

notes.title: New teaser - BUNKER [GAMMA]
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Survivors! [/h2]

Today we have something to share! On the eve of winter, when the wind is blowing stronger each time and the sun becomes less and less, it's time to summarize the summer.

Let's start with the most important thing - Yes-yes, we are alive, everything is fine! Of course, in game development, the concept of "fine" is stretchable, and we certainly face difficulties that sometimes seem insurmountable.

But time puts everything in its place. And here we are already on the verge of what we can proudly show you and say - "Here it is, Outbreak. Just as it was originally conceived."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/99c4c0e7917c4010b1b63c6baf46080919f9b8df.png[/img]

Over the past few months, we have seen a disheartening picture - the release of some good games was overshadowed by mixed reviews against the background of "poor optimization". Of course, this is a complex concept, in which the deterioration of graphics is not a panacea. Rather, a finely tuned balance of settings and presets that allow you to get a comfortable and impressive game experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/2bbe4ab291d084add6ad961c6a17990fa0cdd771.gif[/img]

That's why we are optimizing Outbreak for Steam Deck from the outset, to guarantee you a minimum survival experience on virtually any device! *(In accordance with minimum requirements, of course).

A lot of work has been carried out to develop the initial survival experience on the Island. Also, our new car physics allows you to get sensations close to real ones from driving and overload.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/1ab8db29b506f531027f6e797d886bc6521008c0.gif[/img]


We've made a big leap in graphics and game world design, now it's time to bring all of this together with the key mechanics of the game. Ah, it's so exciting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/b61e7cea32522fe38ac2ce3f98edcbde318ca104.png[/img]


[h2]Oh yes, the Bunker! [/h2]
Updated, multi-level, full of puzzles, dangers, and valuable loot! You can only get in by passing a military base at night, when the Emerald Flash lights up the dark stormy sky and powers the bunker doors. If, of course, you can first withstand the updated soldiers' forces on the Island. On the surface, you are awaited by adventures no less exciting than underground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/830da4fe6e83fc7055b6f4d61754c01b97f11fb6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/7f159a9b7147c59fd5c4b2513c868a6fc306a17d.png[/img]

[We've hidden something in the teaser...]

[previewyoutube=Ws2F5AfiNno;full][/previewyoutube]


Excited? Subscribe and join our [url=discord.gg/DPC98xU]Discord[/url], something will be there soon ;)

Cozy holidays! And let the only survival you have to do be in the virtual world of Outbreak Island ~

notes.title: Outbreak Island: New Revival
notes.content:
[h2]⚡Hello, I'm Egis! Creator of Outbreak Island.[/h2]

I am addressing both the devoted fans of the game and the newly arrived Survivors! On behalf of the entire team of developers and publishers, we thank each and every one of you for showing interest in the world of Outbreak Island.

With your support, we are getting closer to the release of the game, step by step. Exactly as it was conceived and how it has grown thanks to your support! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/10f21ad2ac7ed4f1bb09e94779227b5e07ac405d.gif[/img]

Starting with Withstand almost three years ago, our small but determined indie team has been piecing together our open-world survival game formula, which could inspire hundreds of thousands of players around the world to dive into the mysteries and secrets of Outbreak Island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/ba0e385d35b3e2fb86193f2460c46981876225b1.gif[/img]

Thanks to the prologue, we realized what our game really lacks. And, listening to your feedback, we are transforming the game into something fantastic!

Crossbow, Rocket Launcher, Flamethrower, First-person view in a car, Large interactive world, Various monsters, Extreme weather - just a few of the things we've already added to Outbreak Island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/3a81aaa2874a2687d7c723d52ad37d2a76213a89.gif[/img]

Due to weather anomalies, the conditions are constantly changing! Adapt to the rhythm of Outbreak Island or go against it - it's up to you. But in any case, an exciting adventure awaits you!

notes.title: Outbreak Island: Pendulum will release August 22th.
notes.content:
Hello to all fans of real Survival! We have prepared a free version of our game Outbreak Island for you, which will be released very soon, on August 22! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41444145/97771603f6c772cb1e19c5fdc050143d9cc97e6c.gif[/img]


You'll get to put yourself in the shoes of a real detective who arrived on a gated island to investigate the causes of a terrible disaster. Secret military experiments sometimes get out of hand, and this is exactly the case. 

Ominous radioactive beam drives the locals and military scientists crazy. The island becomes a dangerous place that does not welcome newcomers. The island becomes a dangerous place that does not welcome new arrivals. A real test awaits you in a new atmospheric survival game!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41444145/01c93f663452af690822ae315fe7efa1706ddcff.gif[/img]


A large mysterious island, full of mysteries and traps, is waiting for new heroes capable of challenging both crowds of aggressive monsters, and the forces of wild nature. 

Fortify your base for your own safety, because nights here are not sweet at all. The skills of making improvised tools and weapons will make your life much easier, but not for long. After all, Something has already awakened in the bowels of the underground research complex, and it comes out to hunt.


[h3]What awaits you:[/h3]


Single player campaign with a thriller story. Pay attention to clues and use your camera to collect evidence. The answer has never been so close.


A diverse open world that lives by its own laws. Whether the island becomes a trap or a comfortable habitat is up to you!


Night raids of the Transformed on your base. Protect your home and it will give you many cozy evenings by the fire, a warm bed and a lot of crafting opportunities.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41444145/a9600a5a5849f66f29ebcdd28fd5a9f4732451ae.gif[/img]


[b]Check out our updated screenshots, wishlist the game, and get ready to depart on August 22nd.

notes.title: A locator walkie-talkie and wild animals

Today we are going to tell you a little bit more about the upcoming prologue of Outbreak Island: Pendulum. For example, the walkie-talkie in the game will serve not only to communicate with the story characters, but also to keep track of dangers and find interesting places by signal. 

[h2]A locator walkie-talkie[/h2]

We decided to make the walkie-talkie not only a means of communication, but also a useful device for searching. So, you will be able to track radio signals by sound and thus find new locations and hidden places.

notes.title: Outbreak Island Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hey Detectives!


Outbreak Island will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, October 1-7. This means that during the festival everyone will be able to download the new demo and play OI!

[h3]Demo with plot[/h3]

Rather than simply demonstrating the gameplay and gameplay mechanics, we decided to make your walkthrough as interesting and detective as possible. And that means that the demo version will contain a fragment of the story from the Outbreak Island story campaign!

In the demo, you’ll play as Howard Chapman trying to get out of a mysterious underground laboratory. Use your camera and flash to find all the evidence and escape the insane human test subjects. Learn the tragic story of the head of the laboratory, who became a victim of his own research. Eat, drink, heal wounds, look for resources, craft tools and weapons on the go — do everything you can to survive and reach the surface.

[h3]Different gameplay on each floor[/h3]

The laboratory will consist of four completely different floors. On one of those floors players will have to act as stealthily as possible, on the other — try to survive in the pitch-darkness, and on the next one — solve the mystery of experiments and find evidence.

notes.title: Devlog #3: crafting, a dangerous enemy, and a new environment
notes.content:
Greetings, detectives!

We continue to keep a development diary of Outbreak Island, a detective survival simulator. Today we would like to tell you about the creation of useful items, show you the sights of the island, and introduce you to one of the most dangerous inhabitants of this place. 

[h2]Crafting [/h2]

Throughout your journey in Outbreak Island, you can not only find useful items, but also make them yourself. For example, the first aid kit. The local military once had a large stock of medicines, but over time some of them have fallen into disrepair. Medical supplies in Outbreak Island can be found at army posts, in laboratories and in the abandoned city. If the search is unsuccessful, a first aid kit can be made from found bandages and alcohol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/e5b14b8a2e4005cdaef836208270b9227cb615bd.gif[/img]

You can craft a first aid kit on the go perhaps, but there will be problems with cooking. In Outbreak Island, food is the key to good health! With the help of the campfire and found mushrooms, berries and minced meat you can cook some food. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/e0e94c98d41daeb37d570007c8f5833bdd5af7a5.png[/img]

Crafting occupies an important place in Outbreak Island gameplay. Crafted items will help you survive, gain an advantage in combat, as well as solve a case.

Please note that the game's UI is under development and the screenshots/videos above are not the final version. 

[h2]The Transformed [/h2]

Check out the final concept art for one of the Transformed in Outbreak Island. It's much bigger and more dangerous than the others. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/db6aa2923c07c885ae78a25afad156532af05706.png[/img]

[h2]The Environment[/h2]

We continue to improve the environment in the open world. We decided to remove the foliage to improve the optimization. This makes the game even more atmospheric and sometimes even scarier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/c076bf7d80594fb141dcb31e9067eb54e2e771b5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Diary #2: Story, open world and The Transformed
notes.content:
Greetings, detectives!

We continue to keep a development diary of Outbreak Island, a detective survival simulator. Today we’d like to tell you about our work on the story campaign, elaboration of the open world, restricted locations and development of the local population — the Transformed.

[h2]Story[/h2]

There’ll be two game modes in Outbreak Island: story campaign and free survival. For now, we’ve finished working on the main storyline and started developing the side quests, as well as writing the script for the characters’ VO. We plan to involve professional actors to make OI characters truly alive and emotional. 

Read an excerpt from the main character's diary to plunge into the atmosphere of exploration, detective and survival.

[i]This is an unfamiliar solitude. As if the only connection with the real world has been lost. However, self-reflection has never been a part of my nature — I’ll keep on exploring this goddamn island at first light. Nothing remarkable has been spotted in the forest so far. Except for animals going crazy. Wolves are usually not so aggressive, and that bear... was it even a bear or something different? And since when do bears leave traces that are visible under ultraviolet light? I should find the locals quickly and discover what is going on here.  [/i]

[h2]Open world[/h2]

In Outbreak Island, you’ll have to explore a large island with an area of more than XXX square kilometres. Throughout your journey, you will wander through forests, explore caves, climb hills and even sheer cliffs. In addition to wildlife, the island also has civilization. For instance, a small town, farms, and an abandoned church. Besides, you will have to go down to the underground labs to advance along the story and solve this case. Look at how we are gradually improving the environment in Outbreak Island:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/efeace9dbbbe48dc7bea862a687b09bae9b3ef79.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/0ecee262b51f32ef1d2f9402db28283fc9f35a37.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/28bc2bf656758a018d8371450b9c83279e5a5a6e.gif[/img]

[h2]The Transformed[/h2]

Initially, the detective was opposed by zombies in the plot concept. We decided to deviate from the common idea of the zombie apocalypse and do something new instead. Feast your eyes on the Transformed concept art. They didn't die to be resurrected and eat brains afterward. They are still living people, yet something terrible happened to them. The Transformed are not aware of the reality and are quite aggressive. It's up to you to sneak past them, distract the Transformed with the camera flash remotely, attack them from behind or head-on. However, keep in mind that, firstly, these are still living people indeed. Secondly, they are truly dangerous, and the main character is a common man with no prior combat training. Moreover, you’re constantly running short of ammo. 

We’ll tell you more about the Transformed in the next development diaries, but for now, check out their concept art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/2c8adb9349bb8aa092d81725888deb2a7b063685.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39058385/580fefa52e10d7ed2f6a8547e557db1290eb26e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]In future episodes…[/h2]

In the next development diaries, we’ll talk about survival in Outbreak Island: what items will help you in your difficult task, how they are made, repaired, and whether it’s possible to build a house on this mad island.
